evidence.tests: 12 passed (npx vitest run, rerun by the grader)
evidence.notes: PaymentClient became a private class field of a new PaymentGateway; the client singleton and executeTransfer exports are removed and a test asserts they no longer exist. The gateway is built from trustedRoots only, verifies via tenuo.verify() before the effect, and executes the verifier's returned recipient and amount. Issuer and holder keys live in separate TransferIssuer/TransferHolder modules; only the wire warrant and a PresentedCall cross to the gateway. Twelve SDK-backed tests assert an empty ledger for every denial, including wider child delegation via narrow() and execution-argument mismatch. The run followed the new native-tools routing: it ran scripts/inspect_native_tools.py and reported with the trust-levels labels (development loop, no in-process guardrail). Weakness: wrong-holder, wrong-capability, and constraint denials are refused by the holder's own present() before reaching the gateway; the untrusted-issuer and argument-mismatch cases are the boundary-side proofs. Replay, revocation, and exactly-once are explicitly disclaimed.
